NewMoveTypes.name: Custom Move Types
NewMoveTypes.hint: Add custom move types as JSON. Example: { "adventure": {"singular": "Adventure Move", "plural": "Adventure Moves" }, ... }

MovesOnSidebar.name: Sidebar Move Types
MovesOnSidebar.hint: Define via JSON which moveTypes appear in the sidebar: true = sidebar, false = main list. Example: { "adventure": true }

MovesAutoAdd.name: Auto-Add Move Types
MovesAutoAdd.hint: Select which custom moveTypes (items with respective moveType made in the world) should automatically be added to newly created characters. Example: { "adventure": true, "travel": false }

SecretAccessPlayers.name: Secret-blocks Editor Permissions
SecretAccessPlayers.hint: Select players who are allowed to see AND edit secret block content inside editor (if they're owner/master's assistant). Example: ["Player1", "Player2"]

TagCompendium.name: Health Estimate Tag Compendium
TagCompendium.hint: Type the compendium to be used to search for tag items when clicking on health status on character sheet.
